findings.message: No npmMinimalAgeGate in .yarnrc.yml. Without it Yarn 4.10.3 (default 0) installs versions published seconds ago. Add 'npmMinimalAgeGate: 10080' (minutes; Yarn 4.10.0 or newer).

notes: lockfile soak check not run (--config-only). npm and Yarn release-age settings do not stop `npm ci` or `yarn install --immutable` from installing a young version that is already locked (verified npm 12.2.0, Yarn 4.18.1); pnpm re-checks locked versions from 11.1.3.

findings.message: No minimumReleaseAge in pnpm-workspace.yaml. pnpm 11 defaults to 1 day in loose mode, which adds young versions to minimumReleaseAgeExclude instead of blocking them; pnpm 10 has no default. Add 'minimumReleaseAge: 10080' (pnpm 10.16.0 or newer).

notes: lockfile soak check not run (--config-only). npm and Yarn release-age settings do not stop `npm ci` or `yarn install --immutable` from installing a young version that is already locked (verified npm 12.2.0, Yarn 4.18.1); pnpm re-checks locked versions from 11.1.3.
